assumptions.statement_zh: 组织方尚未发布官方总体边界与重点区域 polygon，本方案全部几何为 provisional 临时粗略约束，仅用于内容设计与机器校验；官方图形发布后必须整体复算。
assumptions.statement_en: No official boundary or key-area polygons are published yet; all geometry here is provisional and must be recomputed when official data arrives.

assumptions.statement_zh: 容积率、建筑高度、道路红线等法定控制条件未知，本方案不给出任何具体数值结论。
assumptions.statement_en: Statutory controls (FAR, height, redlines) are unknown; this proposal makes no numeric conclusions about them.

assumptions.statement_zh: 地标、公共空间与建筑体量均为原创概念建议，不指向任何既有商标、机构或企业形象，亦不构成建设承诺。
assumptions.statement_en: Landmarks, public spaces and building envelopes are original conceptual suggestions only.

assumptions.statement_zh: AI 公共空间场景仅以匿名聚合数据与人工复核兜底，不设人脸识别门禁或无法人工终止的自动决定。
assumptions.statement_en: AI public-space scenarios rely on anonymous aggregated data with human review; no facial-recognition gates or irreversible automated decisions.

assumptions.statement_zh: 年度活动体系与运营机制均为建议性设计，不代表已确定的政府安排或投资承诺。
assumptions.statement_en: The annual event system is a design suggestion, not a confirmed government arrangement.
